checks.name: Uniform API Error Envelope
checks.details: All error responses conform to { code, message, request_id, details } schema.

checks.name: CSRF Mutation Header Protocol
checks.details: client.ts: Mutations (POST, PUT, DELETE) send x-csrf-token from in-memory session; never stored in localStorage.

checks.name: Session Cookie Isolation
checks.details: Transport uses credentials: "same-origin"; client never reads the session cookie directly, satisfying OWASP.

checks.name: Mock Transport Production Isolation
checks.details: Mock transport registration in main.tsx is strictly guarded by `import.meta.env.DEV && import.meta.env.VITE_USE_MOCK_API === "true"`, guaranteeing zero mock code in production bundles.

checks.name: HTTP Status Code Coverage
checks.details: Client and UI implement distinct handling for 200, 201, 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 429 including 409 stale revision rebasing.
